statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The study is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptoms
The study is ordered to assess the efficacy of current medical management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
The provided records do not sufficiently demonstrate medical necessity
The clinical indication lacks requisite evidence of symptomatic arrhythmia or diagnostic uncertainty
